fields.description: Number of commits ahead of the upstream. Absent when there is no upstream to compare against.
fields.name: ahead

fields.description: Number of commits behind the upstream. Absent when there is no upstream to compare against.
fields.name: behind

fields.description: The branch name, e.g. "main". Absent when HEAD is detached.
fields.name: branch

fields.description: Number of paths with unmerged entries in the index — one per conflicted file, regardless of how many stage entries it has.
fields.name: conflictCount

fields.description: True when the index contains unmerged (conflicted) entries. Derived from conflictCount.
fields.name: hasConflicts

fields.description: The seven-character short form of HEAD's object id, e.g. "a1b2c3d". Not the full SHA — see rawHead for that.
fields.name: headOID

fields.description: True when a cherry-pick is in progress.
fields.name: isMidCherryPick

fields.description: True when a merge is in progress.
fields.name: isMidMerge

fields.description: True when a rebase is in progress.
fields.name: isMidRebase

fields.description: The full form of HEAD's object id, for debugging. A full SHA, or empty on a fresh repository with no commits yet.
fields.name: rawHead

fields.description: Number of files with staged changes.
fields.name: stagedCount

fields.description: Number of files with unstaged changes.
fields.name: unstagedCount

fields.description: Number of untracked files in the working tree.
fields.name: untrackedCount

fields.description: The upstream ref, e.g. "origin/main". Absent when none is set or on a detached HEAD.
fields.name: upstream

exitCodes.meaning: The command completed and returned repository status.
The working directory is not inside a git repository.

summary: Report branch, upstream, ahead/behind, and worktree status in one call.
